audit.why: 51.75% over 657 games, 6/10 difficulty: Fiora owns the first levels, Vladimir owns everything from his first AP item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Fiora first item and 2+ items while the page's own whys[5]/[6] and late text say the late game is Vladimir's; level 1 was marked Skill though whys[0] calls him one of the weakest level 1s.
audit.corrected: win[0] to Fiora, win[5] and win[6] to Vladimir, with the matching full phases[N].side/rating flipped as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claimed Vladimir 'has no Sanguine Pool until 6'.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is a basic ability available from level 2; what actually protects you early is its cooldown — 28s at rank 1, falling to 16s at rank 5. Stating a false availability rule teaches a player to walk into a pool.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real cooldown in whys[0] and early. The untargetable-blanks-Grand-Challenge interaction was already correct and is left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] is titled 'Build MR + anti-heal' but its body was generic trade filler with no anti-heal content.
audit.why: Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal him; Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades (flagged in missingInteractions as needs-antiheal).
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now names Executioner's Calling and the two healing spells.

edits.before: Vlad is one of the weakest level-1s and has no pool until 6 — deny his Q last-hits and set up your first Vital proc.
edits.after: Vlad is one of the weakest level-1s and his pool is not ranked yet — deny his Q last-hits and set up your first Vital proc.

edits.before: Vlad is one of the weakest level-1s in the game, and before he hits 6 he has no Sanguine Pool to escape your Q-Lunge chain. At Levels 2-3 your Q-Vital poke plus the E-Bladework sequence (a guaranteed slow on the first auto, a guaranteed crit on the second) out-trades his Q sustain and E poke — strike the marked Vital for the max-HP true damage rather than trading raw chip, because his Q heals plain poke right back. Sidestep his E (the blood-pool swell takes a beat to land) and keep punishing while he has no W to bail him out.
edits.after: Vlad is one of the weakest level-1s in the game, and Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1, so early it is rarely there to escape your Q-Lunge chain. At Levels 2-3 your Q-Vital poke plus the E-Bladework sequence (a guaranteed slow on the first auto, a guaranteed crit on the second) out-trades his Q sustain and E poke — strike the marked Vital for the max-HP true damage rather than trading raw chip, because his Q heals plain poke right back. Sidestep his E (the blood-pool swell takes a beat to land) and punish every window his W is down.

edits.before: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Vladimir, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until his bar forces the all-in he loses.
edits.after: Executioner's Calling by first back — Transfusion and Hemoplague heal him through every Vital chunk you land.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Dodges your burst. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — 2s untargetable that eats your burst. Bait it first. - Hemoplague: 120s flat — his only real commit. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.
